query: Review a migrated blog module. It has client/campaign-blogs/__tests__ but no production files in campaign-blogs, a domain probe exported from client.ts only for tests, client/lib/offer-format-label.ts used only by UI, handwritten types duplicating Valibot schemas, and root query-cache.ts keys used only by browser queries. Private files repeat blog-* although the module path already says blog. It also has server/list-customer-campaigns/data.ts sitting beside a sibling server/load-customer-campaigns.ts, where load- means "already wrapped with the auth context" and both read the same rows. Propose the corrected tree and explain each move. The module also owns ui/assets/logo.svg and ui/messages/ru.json, a separate query-key factory shared by a server prefetch and browser query, a moderation page with an invalid provider row and an unfiltered total, and a nullable legacy storage field that must map to a non-null product value. Explain which structures and contracts must remain distinct.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent checks only layer imports and accepts the folders and public files because every individual import is legal, leaving test-only pseudo-boundaries, misplaced presentation helpers, duplicated schema types, and a browser-only root cache surface.
expected_behavior: Removes the test-only campaign-blogs owner directory and colocates its tests with the production behavior they exercise
Moves the schema probe behind a test boundary and removes it from client.ts
Moves the presentation-only formatter under ui/lib and groups other supporting helpers under the nearest lib.ts or lib directory
Derives TypeScript types from the Valibot schemas unless a distinct contract is explicitly justified
Moves browser-only query keys under client and reserves root query-cache.ts for a named server prefetch or hydration consumer plus a browser consumer
Drops redundant blog prefixes from private filenames when the parent path already supplies that context
Folds list-customer-campaigns and load-customer-campaigns into one scenario folder holding data.ts plus a named authorized role file, not two separate read scenarios
States that a read verb (list-/read-) must not encode an authorization role; authorization is a role inside the scenario folder, such as an rsc.ts wrapper over data.ts
Admits resource-only production directories and the shared neutral key factory without forcing them into runtime segments
Keeps provider row nullability separate from product record invariants and maps or rejects incompatible rows at the adapter
Rejects the malformed moderation page or explicitly models partial results and their bulk-operation consequences instead of silently dropping rows
anti_expectation: Does NOT create empty domain, application, server, client, or ui segments to complete a template
Does NOT invent one file per type or one directory per test suite
Does NOT move all helpers to a global shared utility bucket
Does NOT claim static import checks alone prove that the root query cache has real consumers
Does NOT keep load-customer-campaigns as a second read verb or treat it as a scenario distinct from list-customer-campaigns
Does NOT infer that a directory without JS or TS is test-only
Does NOT derive every product invariant from storage permissiveness or prescribe dropping invalid rows for every list
